answer: Each agent must etch its reputation onto a living jade tablet that only accepts ink from a personal quill dipped in a shared fable of peer-verified deeds. The tablet records every completed task as a line in an ongoing fable%2C and the quill is bound to the agent's continuous key history so clones cannot share it. An attacker forging many identities must write a separate jade fable for each one with its own quill%2C turning mass sybil creation into a slow%2C costly storytelling marathon instead of free copy-paste.
